QuestionStmt.S: Which group elements have the smallest atomic radii in their respective periods?

Solution.S:
Across a period, the atomic radius decreases from left to right due to increasing nuclear charge. The smallest atomic radii are found in the halogens (group 17), because noble gases (group 18) have larger van der Waals radii and are often not considered in the same trend. Therefore, among the given options, group 17 elements have the smallest atomic radii in their respective periods.

Final Answer: $$\boxed{\text{group 17}}$$
